items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Your character’s name, by the way, I think was Evie Jordan.

ctx.x: Then came the 1970 Hawaii Five O, which you talked about, the death scene. Your character’s name, by the way, I think was Evie Jordan. Also that year was Room 222. Some of these I barely remember myself. ’72 was O’Hara: U.S. Treasury.
That was fun. That was a lot of fun.
